Webcast Presentation On October 19, 2026, the Company will host a webcast to discuss topline results from the APOLLO Phase 3 trial of bitopertin in erythropoietic protoporphyria (“EPP”).

Bitopertin: Phase 3 APOLLO Topline Data Results On October 19, 2026, the Company announced positive topline results from the APOLLO Phase 3 trial of bitopertin in EPP, including X-linked protoporphyria (“XLP”).

Summary of topline results: • Bitopertin achieved statistical significance on both co-primary endpoints vs. placebo: • Reduction in whole-blood metal-free protoporphyrin IX (“PPIX”) from baseline (-41.4% vs. placebo, p<0.0001) • Increase in average monthly total time in light without pain during month 6 (+12.2 hours vs. placebo, p=0.0010) • Bitopertin achieved statistical significance on all secondary endpoints vs. placebo, including: • Reduction in incidence rate of phototoxic reactions over the 6-month treatment period vs. placebo (p<0.0001) • Increase in cumulative total time in light without pain over the 6-month treatment period vs. placebo (p<0.0001) • Increase in change from baseline in average daily sunlight exposure time to prodrome vs. placebo (p=0.0077, adults only) • Bitopertin demonstrated additional quality of life benefits vs. placebo, including improved Patient Global Impression of Change (“PGIC”) score (p<0.0001) and Patient Global Impression of Severity (“PGIS”) score (p<0.0001) • Bitopertin was generally well-tolerated.
